subject: CYCLE-1 DESIGN/HYPOTHESIS: Universal Flex Deck source/API boundary
body: Ticket08 Cycle1 hypothesis: the smallest safe universal Flex Deck is a NEW bounded TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY window, not a mutation of the existing passive fold overlay. Keep FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE so foreground key focus stays with the app; omit FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE only on the deck window so deck-region touches are captured while outside-window touches remain native. Baseline tier performs only Duo-owned/public controls and reads no app pixels/node text and injects no gestures. Current source already uses TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY but marks the fold overlay NOT_FOCUSABLE|NOT_TOUCHABLE; current accessibility metadata does not declare canPerformGestures or canRetrieveWindowContent. Therefore universal app trackpad/keyboard semantics are NOT baseline capabilities. Gesture proxy, semantic node actions, and Shizuku task/input control are separate explicit experimental tiers. Samsung Z Fold7 already provides native Flex Mode panel/touchpad for selected/supported apps, so Duo must avoid duplicate/conflicting panels. Posture hypothesis requires hinge angle + orientation qualifier + hysteresis; hinge angle alone cannot distinguish tabletop from other poses. Runtime behavior remains Fold7-field-gated.

service.blocker: Physical Fold7 runtime behavior not tested
